programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga and Furuichi head off to school to start the new term... except Ishiyama High is still completely destroyed thanks to a certain someone. So instead, all the students from Ishiyama are split up and sent off to different high schools temporarily. Furuichi is all excited since they're heading to St. Ishiyama Academy, the most prestigious school in the area, but when they get there the reality of exactly how they are treated becomes apparent...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga gains his own follower in Kazuya, who will do anything to become strong like Oga. Oga, increasingly annoyed at Kazuya tailing him everywhere, finally decides to train him. Meanwhile, Aoi is jealous of how easily Azusa, Kazuya's childhood friend, can act cute and girly in front of a guy, and invites her for a little chat to the shrine where she lives.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Angelica is visiting the Human World for her birthday, and Furuichi is all excited for his big sleepover! But Angelica brought an unexpected gift with her from the Demon World... Yes, they're back! It's a Yople Alien! Knowing the grave danger this poses the city, nay, the world, Angelica does the only thing you can do in this situation: Recruit a 5 member squad of pseudo magical girls and partner with a muscled Moyashi-man to defeat the Blue Ears and save the day!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Sadohara thinks that by making the Ishiyama students do their own physical examinations that they're sure to cause trouble, which would be enough to get them all expelled! But when Furuichi and Oga end up hiding under a desk while the girls get changed, they've got trouble of a whole other kind...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Raising Baby Beel isn't getting any easier, and Oga is determined once again to find someone to dump him off on. Oga thinks maybe it takes more than brawn to attract Baby Beel, and starts to search for someone with brains, too! At the same time, rumors of a secret school group made of elite athletes whose job it is to enforce the school's moral code start going around, and members of Ishiyama's special class stop showing up to school... Who exactly are these 6 Holy Knights?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga and Furuichi go off in search of the rest of the 6 Holy Nights, but meanwhile Shiroyama is being picked on by some of St. Ishiyama's students, who know he can't fight back or risk getting expelled. It doesn't take long for the 6 Holy Knights to call out all of Ishiyama to the roof for a real showdown!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The top of Ishiyama duke it out with the 6 Holy Knights on the roof! Miki explains how he looked up to Oga back in middle school, and now wants to prove that he's surpassed him with his powerful punching, but before they can settle things the final 2 of the 6 Holy Knights show up, and call off the battle. The next day, Oga and the gang are all set to be expelled!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The sport for Ishiyama's showdown with the 6 Holy Knights has been decided... It's volleyball! Kunieda is all ready to start practice when a mysterious transfer student arrives... Actually, it's Hilda, who for some reason has decided to get involved... But can she find a way to actually get the guys motivated to practice?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga gets tired of volleyball practice and stumbles upon Miki practicing his special move in a dojo. Miki and Oga decided to "spar" with each other, and Miki asks Oga why he betrayed him in the past... Finally, the truth behind Miki's thirst for beating Oga will be revealed!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: It's finally the day of the Saint Ishiyama School Festival and the big volleyball match! But the match doesn't happen until the afternoon, so Furuichi decides to enjoy the school festival atmosphere, specifically the Maid Cafe that Azusa and her class are running. Unfortunately things get a bit out of hand...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The match between Ishiyama and the 6 Holy Knights is here, and this is not your usual volleyball! With their pride and their educational future on the line, the Ishiyama gang puts it all out there on the court! Will Furuichi the Strategist be their trump card?

programme.desc: A truly epic battle erupts when Edward, Mustang, Hawkeye, Greed, Izumi, and Armstrong attack the god-like Father. The odds are against the forces of good - until one brave boy makes a shocking sacrifice.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E63 The Other Side of the Gateway [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the battle ends, the one known as Father meets his final fate beyond the Gateway. When the one known as Fullmetal enters the sacred space, he finds only the promise of a new beginning.

programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E64 Journey's End [English Dub]

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP01 The Revived Phantom Thief Kid [English Dub]
programme.desc: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. At first, high school student and master illusionist Kaito seeks to challenge the magic trick-wielding outlaw out of pride, but then he learns that his deceased father was actually Kid the Phantom Thief, so who is the newcomer? Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP02 Blue Birthday [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito finds himself double-booked when a theft he announced beforehand is on the same night as Aoko's birthday party. Complicating matters is the appearance of a group of jewel-collecting thugs who may have had something to do with the murder of Kaito's father.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP03 Hustler vs. Magician [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP04 A Great Detective Comes to Light [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP05 Scarlet Seduction [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP06 Black Star [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief attempts a bold clock tower robbery in a building swarming with the police, but his real rival takes the stage here for the first time, turning the endeavor into a fierce battle of wits!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP07 Kuroba Kaito's Busy Day Off [English Dub]
programme.desc: When Inspector Nakamori catches a glimpse of Kaito's face during an attempted robbery, the young magician has to "prove" he's not Kid the Phantom Thief by going on a date with Aoko at the same time Kid is supposed to make his next appearance!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP08 Adult's Charm [English Dub]
programme.desc: Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP09 Enter: The Phantom Lady [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the present, Kaito and Aoko are lured into a trap at the top of the Toto Tower, while in the past, the first Kid the Phantom Thief and the mysterious Phantom Lady have an exciting first encounter at the top of the Eiffel Tower!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP10 Phantom Lady and the Ryoma Treasure [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's first order of business is saving himself and an unconscious, handcuffed Aoko as they plummet from the top of Toto Tower in an antique car. Assuming he succeeds, the next challenge is finishing his mother's last job, bringing a crooked antiques dealer to justice. But his mother never had to deal with the brilliant diminutive detective, Edogawa Conan!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP11 Kid, Conan, and the Ryoma Treasure Illusion [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP12 Two Kid the Phantom Thieves [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

programme.title: Me Feelins is Hurt 1940
programme.desc: Olive writes a letter to Popeye: she's through with sailors; it's cowboys for her. Popeye immediately sails off to the West, where he finds, who else, Bluto as the head of the ranch where Olive is enthralled. Bluto gives Popeye a wild horse to ride, and, after a few humiliating defeats, Popeye conquers it (and wins back Olive's heart). Bluto punches Popeye out, and into the clutches of what can best be described as a rattlesnake constrictor. Bluto then starts menacing Olive, so Popeye eats his spinach, saves her, and defeats Bluto and his gang.

programme.title: The Crystal Brawl 1957
programme.desc: Bluto muscles out Popeye to take Olive to the fair. Popeye rushes ahead and poses as a fortune teller, luring Olive in. He shows Olive her future (actually, her past) in the crystal ball: first, a clip of a mountain climbing sequence that culminates in Bluto assaulting Olive. Then, a clip from another amusement park showing strongman Bluto stealing Olive away to a roller-coaster while Popeye rings a strength-testing bell repeatedly. Olive, having seen this, no longer wants anything to do with Bluto and walks out. Bluto exposes Popeye and chases Olive into a Tunnel of Love; Popeye follows and trashes Bluto.

programme.title: Boo Moon
programme.desc: Casper emerges from a subway station, following a crowd of scared strangers. He encounters a man saying "see the wonders of the moon for ten cents," and offering a sight through a telescope. Casper scares the man away, then uses the telescope to see the moon. He then flies to the moon for a visit. Casper lands on the moon, disappointed to find no man on the moon. He lies down to nap, then tiny moon men emerge from holes. They capture Casper, like Lilliputians did to Gulliver, then place him in a cage on wheels, in which they tow him to the Ruler of the Moon, King Luna. The King addresses Casper as a monster, and treats him as an enemy. Casper playfully picks up King Luna, and the king has him placed in the royal dungeon. A dejected Casper is imprisoned. Then animated trees attack the city of the moon men. The moon men defend their fortified city with flaming missiles. The tree monsters fight back with water, then break through the town walls. When the fight seems lost to the tree monsters, Casper escapes his cage, and helps the moon men. Casper goes underground. The friendly ghost then pulls trees' parts through the moon surface and ties them together, immobilizing the trees. The frustrated trees writhe and strain against the knots Casper has tied. Casper and the moon men have won. Then, and only then, does King Luna embrace Casper as a friend. King Luna knights Casper for the valiant defense of his people. Then all the moon men join in singing the Casper theme song.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application? Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: Global business voices on China-US trade relations
programme.desc: China-US relations draws global attention, the global business community is closely watching what US President Donald Trump's visit to China means for trade, investment and market confidence. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN’s Lincoln Humphries sits down with Fred Teng, president of the AmericaChina Public Affairs Institute, Chris Torrens, chairman of the British Chamber of Commerce in China, and Oliver Oehms, executive director and board member of the German Chamber of Commerce in China – North China; exploring investment sentiment, business trends and why China-US cooperation still matters in an uncertain global economy.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programme.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programme.title: Around China: Explore Lijiang's vibrant nighttime economy with Naxi culture
programme.desc: In recent years, Lijiang, Yunnan Province, has been leveraging its unique local resources to enrich and elevate its nighttime economy. Join CGTN Reporter Zhu Zhu to immerse in the Naxi ethnic wear, taking part in a bonfire party at Sifang Street, and explore Lijiang’s nighttime economy firsthand!

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: Welcome to Chongqing, China's largest city. Located in the country's southwest, it straddles two mighty rivers and is famed for its extraordinary skyline, with high-rises mushrooming out of the hills and vertigo-inducing bridges.But Tianran He and Angela Fu are here for the food: From xiaomian noodles and Jianghu cuisine to the city's most famous dish: Chongqing hotpot, our hosts take on the spicy, numbing and scintillating aromas of Chongqing cuisine. We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Rhythms of the Forest: A Sound of Li Instruments
programme.desc: Li bamboo and wood instruments offer a journey into the unique sounds of Hainan's Li ethnic group. Explore the ancient craftsmanship and musical heritage, from the resonant tones of bamboo flutes to the percussive rhythms of wooden drums. Experience the natural melodies that tell the stories of the Li people.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith

programme.title: Midnight Machu Picchu
programme.desc: Lit only by starlight, marvel at nighttime views of Machu Picchu to ambient tunes.

programme.title: Cosmic trio
programme.desc: Behold two swirling galaxies and Sagittarius C—a star-forming region—set to ambient music.

programme.title: A glacier aglow
programme.desc: A glacier bathed in starlight and the aurora borealis shines bright to ambient music.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: In the tunnels of a leafcutter ant nest, we uncover a Central American coral snake sharing the burrow. Nigel meets a rattlesnake without a rattle, and a young Mexican cantil uses its white tail tip to attract prey close for a deadly strike.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Snakes are highly-adapted to survive in the scorching deserts of Arabia, and Nigel's skills are tested to find his top ten. Will the saw-scaled viper's venom and lightning reflexes be a match for the backwards strike of the puff adder?

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50°C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water. Amphibians bury themselves in mud to escape dehydration. The rest of the wild must wait for the cool of the night to move.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds, and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead. Though the landscape looks bleak and barren at a glance, there is life thriving here.

programme.title: Shark Heroes
programme.desc: Cristina Zenato arrived in the Bahamas to do a couple of months of diving – more than 28 years later she’s still there, and is now known for her passion for helping sharks. While she’s met and helped all kinds, from Hammerheads and Tiger sharks, the most common ones she deals with are the Caribbean Reef Shark.

programme.title: Shark Heroes
programme.desc: Whale Sharks are the gentle giants of the Shark family, stretching 18m or 59 feet, they are filter feeders and inhabit warmer waters. Dr. Mark Meekhan and his colleague Christine Barry have been studying these majestic creatures in the Ningaloo Reef area of Western Australia, and share insights from their time with the whale shark as we go out aboard their boat in the pursuit of science.

programme.title: Shark Heroes
programme.desc: From the crystal clear waters of Lord Howe to the murky depths of Sydney Harbour, come with scientists Dr. Vic Peddemors and Dr. Amy Smoothey as they study one of the most unique and feared sharks in our waters – the Bull Shark – seen as dangerous because it’s an opportunistic hunter, that swims in both salt and fresh water, the bull shark will rise from below prey un-detected.

programme.title: Shark Heroes
programme.desc: From the depths of caves in Australia we spring around the globe to the sparkling waters of The Bahamas – where second generation boat captain, Neal Watson Jr., takes us to Tiger Beach – a sandy quay that is submerged but close to the surface that Tiger Sharks call home.

programme.title: Shark Heroes
programme.desc: Explore the multitude of sharks that call the Maldives home – surrounded by the Indian Ocean, Fuvahmulah at the southern tip of the chain really does have it all. Thresher Sharks, schooling Hammerheads, Grey Reef Sharks, Oceanic White Tips, Whale Sharks, and the star of the show is the Tiger Sharks.

programme.title: Shark Heroes
programme.desc: Great White Sharks circle the waters of South Australia and we jump in the water with the Port Lincoln shark dive team, out near the Neptune Islands, right in the middle of a shark meeting point in between the West Coast and East Coast populations that meet here in the middle of the country.

programme.title: Volcanoes: The Fires Within
programme.desc: Volcanoes: The Fires Within will take audiences around the world with National Geographic photographer, Carsten Peter, to get dangerously close to volcanoes. Audiences will learn about how volcanoes have impacted humans for millennia -- from continents, to ecosystems, to wildlife habitats.

programme.title: Space Junk
programme.desc: After 50 years of launching our dreams into space, we're left with a troubling legacy: a growing ring of orbiting debris that casts a shadow over the future of space exploration. Space Junk 3D is a visually explosive, sensory expanding voyage into our now-threatened Final Frontier. Experience mind-boggling collisions, both natural and manmade. Soar from the stunning depths of Meteor Crater to an unprecedented view of our increasingly crowded orbits -- 22,000 miles above Earth. Join us as the foremost expert, also known as the "Father of Space Junk," guides us through the challenges we face in protecting them, forging a new age of space discovery.

programme.desc: Alaska: Spirit of the Wild is the ultimate story of survival, where life triumphs season after season against fierce conditions and challenges.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey
programme.desc: 500 million years ago life left this blue womb and colonized the land, but we are still intricately linked to the ocean. Our climates, coastlines, ecosystems, and economies are tied to the perpetual movement of water between continents. The great ocean currents are the arteries and veins of Planet Earth! This is the story of one particularly fascinating flow – the East Australian Current, a massive oceanic river that stretches the length of Australia's east coast.

programme.title: Animal Kingdom: A Tale of Six Families
programme.desc: Animal Kingdom is a stunning exploration into just what makes our natural world so spectacular. An educational journey from A-Z, the film introduces junior audiences to animals from all over the world; and explores the ways in which we can help to protect them. Across frozen snowy forests, under scorching African Sun, and into the darkest depths of the ocean, the film will break down why animals are the way they are and answer the simple but important questions that form the basis of our knowledge about the animal world.

programme.desc: Marvel at clear, starlit skies as the bonfire roars and immersive, ambient sound sets the mood.

programme.title: Sharks (3DE) - (IMAX film)
programme.desc: Presented by Jean-Michel Cousteau, Sharks 3D is a breathtaking new three-dimensional film experience that offers audiences an astonishing up-close encounter with the Lions and Tigers of the Ocean.

programme.title: Sea Lions: Life by a Whisker
programme.desc: Between a jagged cliff face and a roaring ocean, lives a colony of Australian Sea Lions. In an environment equally as harsh as it is beautiful, be immersed in a classic coming of age tale guided by one of Australia's most unique, intelligent, and playful animals. Take an intimate journey inside the colony where a life of great intimacy, tenderness, and clumsiness, must often give way to a life of great sacrifice and bravery. Dive into the world of a rare Australian Sea Lion pup - and meet the people that are trying to save her species.

programme.title: Mummies: Secrets of the Pharaohs
programme.desc: Journey to the royal tombs of Egypt and explore the history of ancient Egyptian society as told through the mummies of the past. The film follows explorers and scientists as they piece together the archeological and genetic clues of Egyptian mummies, and provides audiences with a window into the fascinating and mysterious world of the pharaohs. To unwrap the secrets of the pharaohs is to perhaps glimpse the future of our own civilization.

programme.title: Vikings: Journey to New Worlds
programme.desc: They came from the North and soon the legend would say that they didn't know fear. For hundreds of years, they were another name for "terror." They were warriors, slavers, traders, explorers but also farmers, settlers, poets, loyal family members, and skilled craftsmen. Vikings tells their story.

programme.title: Turtle Odyssey
programme.desc: Sea turtles are some of Earth's most ancient and majestic creatures. For over 100 million years, they have traversed the seas, enduring mass extinctions and playing critical roles in maintaining food webs. But now they face a new threat – humans. It's time we learned more about these remarkable reptiles.

programme.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
programme.desc: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

programme.title: To The Ends Of The Earth
programme.desc: The rise of extreme energy, the end of economic growth, the people caught in the middle. To the Ends of the Earth is a feature documentary about the state of our energy system today, and the people we meet are uniquely positioned to watch this global crossroads unfold. For example, the mayor of an Inuit village in Canada's high Arctic who is concerned that seismic testing for oil in the ocean is blowing up the eardrums of the animals that the Inuit hunt to survive. Or the environmental lawyer who goes on a journey to areas that produce energy for the Tarsands of Alberta – he learns of the inputs of energy that have to be put into this resource - and the reasons why the second largest oil project in the world is economically unsustainable. Or the river conservationist in Utah who fights to protect the Colorado River from oil shale projects that would disturb its headwaters.

programme.title: Secret Ocean
programme.desc: Jean-Michel Cousteau, son of ocean pioneer Jacques Cousteau, offers a breakthrough look at a secret world within the ocean that is perhaps the biggest story of all—that the smallest life in the sea is the mightiest force on which we all depend. Alongside marine biologist Holly Lohuis, he invites viewers to dive into this whole new world that will leave them in awe of the beauty and diversity of the oceans – the source of all life on our planet – and inspire an even stronger desire to protect what they have either seen for the first time or perhaps re-discovered along the journey.

programme.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea
programme.desc: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge.

programme.title: Beavers
programme.desc: An acclaimed, intimate look at one beaver family and their aquatic habitat which puts a remarkably human face on these amazing creatures' emotions.

programme.title: Ocean Oasis
programme.desc: Plunge into the wildly spectacular Sea of Cortes and join beautiful naturalist Iliana Ortega to swim with whales, dolphins, sharks, and giant manta rays.

programme.desc: Volcanoes: The Fires Within will take audiences around the world with National Geographic photographer, Carsten Peter, to get dangerously close to volcanoes. programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: The Ultimate Wave Tahiti
programme.desc: The Ultimate Wave Tahiti follows eleven-time World Champion surfer Kelly Slater and Tahitian surfer Raimana Van Bastolear as they explore the nature of waves and hunt for the ultimate wave-riding experience at the famed Pacific surf site of Teahupoo, Tahiti.

programme.title: Serengeti: Journey to the Heart of Africa
programme.desc: Life happened in the Serengeti on an unprecedented scale. It's home to most of Africa's most iconic animals, and hosts one of the world's greatest natural events — the annual wildebeest migration. Nature has orchestrated a perfect symphony in which every species has a very distinct role to play in a larger story -- the balance of an entire ecosystem. We'll see it through the eyes of the youngest members of our animal cast as they imitate their parents, and learn about the mighty roles they'll play. Prepare to be awed by this immersive Giant Screen film about how nature works in one of the world's greatest ecosystems.

programme.title: Angkor: The Lost Empire of Cambodia
programme.desc: At the height of its power between the 9th and 15th centuries, Angkor was a resplendent city, considered the most extensive urban complex of the pre-industrial world. But by the late 16th century, the empire was in its death throes. The people of Angkor left not a single word explaining their kingdom's collapse. Come along this giant screen adventure to unveil the mysteries behind this lost jewel of Cambodia!

programme.title: Search for the Great Sharks
programme.desc: From the coast of California to the remote reaches of South and Western Australia, this film pursues blue sharks, whale sharks, and the notorious great white to allow viewers an up-close experience.

programme.title: Amazing Journeys
programme.desc: Experience the world's greatest animal migrations from zebras in East Africa, to millions of red crabs on Christmas Island, to gray whales in Mexico's beautiful lagoons, and monarch butterflies in the Mexican highlands. Travel back in time among exotic tribes of Africa to explore the roots of human migration.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel explores almost every type of environment in China, climbing steep forested slopes and even wading into a sea cave to track down his top ten. But which is number one?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Costa Rica has two venomous snakes for every hectare of land, including some of the world's most feared tropical snakes. Which of these kings of the jungle will make it to the top of Nigel's list?

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky (2024)
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. programme.desc: Naast schietvaardigheid en lange-afstand-schieten, worden militaire sluipschutters getraind in veel andere vaardigheden: spotten, achtervolgen, camouflage, infiltratie, speciale verkenning en doelzoeken. Kortom, Nick en Laura kunnen veel leuke dingen ontdekken op het gebied van schieten en wetenschap!

programme.title: Heavy Metal Monsters S1
programme.desc: Wat doe je als je meer dan 160 kilometer verwijderd bent van de dichtstbijzijnde weg? Dan haal je het grote geschut erbij. En er zijn maar weinig machines groter dan de Boeing Vertol heavy lift helikopter.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Monsters S1
programme.desc: In de heuvels ten westen van St. Louis, Missouri, loopt een panter rond. De Prinoth Panther is het ultieme all-terrain, multifunctionele werkvoertuig. Het is een kraan, het is een tractor, het is een graafmachine: het is alles wat je nodig hebt.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Monsters S1
programme.desc: 1800 meter hoog in de Rocky Mountains van Colorado ligt de Colewyo kolenmijn. Deze pleke produceert een ijzingwekkende 2,3 miljoen ton steenkool per jaar om de Craig energiecentrale te voorzien van de brandstof die nodig is om 1300 megawatt elektriciteit te leveren aan het Tri-State gebied.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.sub-title: Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf
programme.desc: In de historische fabriek van Lea & Perrins ontrafelt Lord Prescott het verhaal achter de legendarische Worcestershiresaus, die al sinds 1837 wordt geproduceerd. Daarna reist hij door naar Manchester, waar hij de Soreen-fabriek bezoekt, de thuisbasis van de geliefde malt loaf. Daar draait hij mee op de productielijn en experimenteert hij met een nieuwe smaak.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.sub-title: Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish
programme.desc: Om te ontdekken hoe zijn favoriete maaltijd — fish & chips gevolgd door rijstpudding — wordt gemaakt, bezoekt Lord Prescott de Ambrosia-fabriek in Devon om het productieproces van klassieke Britse desserts te verkennen. Daarna reist hij terug naar het noorden, naar Grimsby, waar hij bij de Young’s-fabriek leert hoe hun beroemde vispastei wordt gemaakt.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.desc: Op zoek naar de ultieme Britse combinatie — thee en biscuits — reist Lord Prescott naar Liverpool, waar hij de Typhoo-theefabriek bezoekt en ontdekt wat er nodig is voor een perfect gezet kopje thee. Terug in Yorkshire stopt hij bij de Fox’s-biscuitsfabriek, waarmee hij zijn reis afsluit met een echte Britse traktatie.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1
programme.desc: Een terugblik op de geschiedenis van steeds sterkere, snellere en krachtigere militaire vliegtuigen.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1
programme.desc: Ultimate Combat Helicopters biedt een boeiend perspectief op de technologie achter de krachtigste gevechtshelikopters van vandaag de dag.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1
programme.desc: Beleef de ultieme adrenalinekick – de snelste en meest angstaanjagende attracties ter wereld.

programme.title: The Aviators S3
programme.desc: Sara en Anthony nemen samen met ons de checklists door en laten zien welke stappen piloten op de grond nemen om ervoor te zorgen dat alles in de lucht volgens plan verloopt.

programme.title: The Aviators S3
programme.desc: We maken kennis met de man die als geen ander ter wereld met een standaard Stearman uit 1947 vliegt en verkennen het vliegtuig waarmee gevechtspiloten worden geïntroduceerd in het landen op vliegdekschepen.

programme.title: The Aviators S3
programme.desc: De Wisconsin Air National Guard voegt een jet-aangedreven knal toe aan het einde van het volkslied tijdens een Nascar-race op Road America.

programme.title: Space Greed S1

programme.desc: De mens is altijd hebzuchtig geweest. Zeker wanneer het om de behoefte voor energie gaat. Wie weet betalen we in de toekomst abonnementskosten voor zonlicht?

programme.title: Space Greed S1

programme.desc: Wanner we eenmaal infrastructuur hebbben gebouwd om op gevaarlijke plekken buiten de aarde te leven, waarom zouden we dan niet verder willen ontwikkelen?

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.sub-title: Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?
programme.desc: Elke raket die wordt gelanceerd, heeft invloed op de atmosfeer. Kan de aarde elk jaar de honderden of zelfs duizenden lanceringen van brandstofverslindende raketten overleven?

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1

programme.desc: Jack ontmoet een man die geen gezichten kan herkennen en stelt een superherkennen op de proef.

programme.title: Omerta
programme.desc: Omerta (2018) is a gripping biographical thriller about Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British-born terrorist involved in kidnappings and the murder of journalist Daniel Pearl.

programme.title: Anjaana Anjaaani
programme.desc: The film of two strangers, who meet on a bridge intending to commit suicide. After bonding over their shared miseries,they make a pact to live life to the fullest for the next 20 days and explore various adventures together. As they embark on this trip, they begin to develop feelings for each other, leading to a complex and emotional journey. Will they embrace their new-found love or stick to their original plan?

programme.title: Kisaan
programme.desc: The story of a farmer, Maan Singh, who struggles to save his ancestral land from corrupt officials and greedy businessmen. With the help of his son, he fights against the system and stands up for his rights as a farmer. The movie highlights the challenges faced by farmers in modern India and explores themes of family, tradition, and social justice in a poignant and inspiring plot.

programme.title: Gumnaam The Mystery
programme.desc: An aspiring actress, Ria who models and acts in music videos is offered a lead role in a film by casting director Rishi Gandhi. However, when she arrives at the director's mansion, she begins to realise that things are not as they seem.

programme.title: The Dirty Picture
programme.desc: A biographical drama film inspired by the life of South Indian actress Silk Smitha. The movie follows the journey of a young woman, who dreams of becoming a film star. It depicts her rise to fame in the film industry and politics, her turbulent personal life, and the challenges she faces as a woman in a male-dominated industry.

programme.title: R D Burman – Musical Maverick
programme.desc: A powerhouse collection of R.D. Burman's iconic hits, blending innovation, emotion, and energy. From soulful ballads to electrifying grooves, experience the genius of Pancham Da that defined Bollywood's golden soundscape.

programme.title: Best Of 70s – The Golden Era
programme.desc: Step into Bollywood’s most soulful decade with this jukebox of evergreen melodies. A rich tapestry of romance, innocence, and timeless charm – pure nostalgia from the golden 70s.

programme.title: Best Of 90s – Filmy Beats Reloaded
programme.desc: Take a ride through the vibrant 90s with peppy love anthems, dramatic duets, and emotional melodies. This jukebox celebrates the signature style of Bollywood's musical revival decade.

programme.title: Rajesh Khanna – The Superstar's Anthems
programme.desc: Revisit the unmatched charm of Rajesh Khanna with this jukebox of unforgettable melodies. Romantic, philosophical, and heartfelt – these songs defined an era and a superstar.

programme.title: Jeetendra Hits The Jumping Jack
programme.desc: Dive into Jeetendra’s iconic hits—The Jumping Jack’s timeless energy! Relive the magic of Bollywood’s golden era with foot-tapping beats, romance, and pure nostalgia!

programme.title: Neetu Singh Evergreen Hits
programme.desc: Turn up the retro vibes with Neetu Singh’s greatest hits! A birthday playlist packed with nostalgia, romance, and endless charm.

programme.title: Superhits Of 90s
programme.desc: Relive the '90s with Superhits! Romantic melodies, peppy beats, and timeless nostalgia—dance, sing along, and fall in love all over again!

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There is a space invasion under Jon Arbuckle's roof, and the aliens are looking very much like Garfield's favourite meal: lasagnas.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.desc: Squeak and his mice family have taken up residence in Garfield's house, to Jon's despair, who will deprive Garfield of lasagnas if he doesn't turn things back to normal.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield's favourite restaurant, Vito's Pizzeria, is in jeopardy. The evil Mama Meany wants to buy it to expand his own restaurant, with the PizzaGrand 7000 capable of making ten pizzas a minute.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A mother bluebird is locked in a neighbourhood garage, so who will care for her eggs? That's a job for Garfield, who is sometimes quite a mother hen.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie is found by Al the Dogcatcher with no license on his collar so he puts him in the city pound with other stray dogs. Garfield will do everything to get his friend back.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie falls in love with a brush. Garfield becomes a little bit jealous about that and decides to make the brush disappear.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.sub-title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
programme.desc: Jon finds an old accordion. It's unbearable for Garfield who totally dislikes this music. He will do everything to get rid of it.
